rows.title: Save and continue on the transporter list goes on to 'Upload documents' in the journey run
rows.detail: In Design Release 2.1 the transporter list is followed by the documents page, so a trader running through the journey who chooses a transporter and saves moves on to 'Upload documents', at its real path, instead of landing on the overview. Opened from its overview task, the list still returns to the overview. This changes only where today's transporter list leads: the afternoon ruling of 9 October lets work over today's transporter step go ahead while transporter management waits, so the list itself stays as it is today.
acceptanceCriteria: Reached from arrival details in the journey run, 'Save and continue' on the transporter list, with a transporter chosen, goes to the 'Upload documents' page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-108; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-093; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 48)

Opened from its task on the overview, 'Save and continue' on the transporter list, with a transporter chosen, returns to the overview. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-198)
The chosen transporter is still chosen when the trader goes back to the list from 'Upload documents'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-108)

In the journey run, saving a transporter added from the list's 'Add a transporter' also carries the trader on to 'Upload documents', as the list's own 'Save and continue' does. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-051; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 48)

rows.title: The transporter list's buttons when amending a notification or editing a template
rows.detail: When today's transporter list is reached while amending a submitted notification, or while editing a template from its review, it ends with the controls Design Release 2.1 gives those modes, so the trader can return to where they came from. The controls go on today's list as it stands: its blocked Design Release 2.1 changes (layout, search, shipped records) do not hold them up. Template mode is the animals sets' only; plants pages have none.
acceptanceCriteria: When the notification is being amended, the transporter list ends with a primary 'Save and return' that goes back to the review, a secondary 'Save and continue' and a link-style 'Save and return to overview'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-043; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 48)

When the transporter list is edited from a template review, it ends with a single 'Save and return' button, which goes back to the template, and a 'Cancel' link back to the template, and shows no other save button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-044; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 48; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 34; conflicts:c-286)
In both modes the list's content, search and choice of transporter are today's: only its closing controls change. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 31; conflicts:c-286)

rows.title: A germinal products notification chooses its transporter from its own copy of today's transporter step
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1's germinal journey chooses its transporter from the same transporter page as the live-animals journeys. Following the 9 October rulings, the germinal products set gets its own copy of today's transporter step, taken from the live-animals set as it stands when the copy is built: the transporter list, 'Choose a transporter type' and both add forms, with the same content, controls and validation, on the germinal journey's own pages. It leaves out the unused approved commercial transporter register page. Added transporters belong to the organisation, not to a set, so a germinal notification offers the same transporters as a live-animals one. The live-animals transporter changes that wait on transporter requirements reach the germinal copy when the transporter area is re-distilled.
acceptanceCriteria: In a germinal products notification, the transport step shows the transporter list with the same caption, heading, search, 'Add a transporter' button, columns and shipped transporters as the live-animals transporter list shows at the time. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-009)
Saving the germinal transporter list with nothing chosen shows the same error as the live-animals list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49)

From the germinal transporter list, 'Add a transporter' opens a germinal 'Choose a transporter type' page, and each type opens its germinal add form, each with the same copy, buttons and error messages as the live-animals page it copies. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49)
Every germinal transporter page is at /germinal-products/notifications/{journeyId}/ followed by the live-animals page's slug. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

The germinal set has no 'Search for an approved commercial transporter' page: opening the register page's slug under a germinal notification shows the service's page not found. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-146)

Saving a complete transporter on a germinal add form makes it the notification's transporter and carries the germinal journey on from the germinal transporter list, as the live-animals add form does from its list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49)

A transporter the organisation added on a live-animals notification is on the transporter list of its next germinal products notification, ready to pick, and one added on a germinal notification is on its next live-animals notification's list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)
Picking a transporter on a germinal notification and saving keeps it chosen when the trader returns to the germinal transporter list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102)

rows.title: The transporter list matches DR2.1: its layout, search, columns and shipped transporters
rows.detail: A trader choosing a transporter sees the list laid out as Design Release 2.1 lays it out: a visible 'Select a transporter' sub-heading above the search and the table, the 'Add a transporter' button beside the search rather than below the table, 'Not applicable' where a transporter has no approval number, and a search run from an icon button that also matches a transporter's type and status. With JavaScript the search filters the rows in the page; without it the icon button submits the term and the server filters. The service ships DR2.1's eight transporters (four commercial, four private), replacing the two placeholder commercial records. The list's error and no-match search states are checked for accessibility like its other states. Blocked: listing and searching transporters is transporter management, which waits on transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: The transporter list shows a visible sub-heading 'Select a transporter' above the search box and the transporter table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-015; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-076)

The radio group round the transporter table keeps the legend 'Select a transporter', visually hidden, so it is announced but not shown twice. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-083)

rows.title: Find a commercial transporter's Northern Ireland address with an address search
rows.detail: DR2.1 lets a trader adding a commercial transporter search for a Northern Ireland address instead of typing it, and fills the blank address fields from the address chosen. The search calls the same INS backend address lookup as the other address searches and keeps only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. With JavaScript the address and contact fields start hidden behind the search and an 'Enter address manually' button. The lookup stub gains Northern Ireland addresses so the search and the fill can be seen in the fit suites and on the local stack. Blocked twice: on the address lookup becoming a real feature, and on transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: In the fit suites, on the local stack and in CDP dev, the commercial transporter form offers an address search labelled 'Search for an address' with the placeholder 'Start typing...' and a search icon button named 'Search', and lists the addresses found under 'Address search results'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-093, prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-094, prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-098; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-127; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-059)

The search offers only Northern Ireland addresses: in the fit suites and on the local stack a search lists the lookup stub's addresses whose postcode starts 'BT' and none of its London addresses; in CDP dev it lists only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 34-35; repo:stub AddressLookupSimulatorController; conflicts:c-218)

Choosing an address from the results fills address line 1, address line 2, town or city and postcode wherever the trader left the field blank, from what the lookup returns, and leaves the name, the county and every field the trader filled as they were. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-095; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 35; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-060)

With JavaScript the form's address fields and 'Enter contact details' section start hidden behind the address search and an 'Enter address manually' link-style button that reveals them; they already show when an address has been looked up, when address line 1 has a value, when an address field has an error or after any failed save, keeping the search text and the picked address. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-096, prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-097; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-061, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-070; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-128)
Without JavaScript every address and contact field shows from the start, and the form saves from typed values alone. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 35; conflicts:c-006)
